x: USA's Jon Drummond was always sure that Dwain was going to get up there, going so far as to place a bet with Italian Stefano Tilli. As Drummond recalled afterwards, Chambers had been written off to a certain extent with most onlookers expecting Jason Gardner to carry the first British vest across the line.
